items.text: Sorting U.S. common stocks into deciles on trailing twelve-month idiosyncratic volatility yields a long-short spread of -0.62% per month (t = -3.41) over 1996-2023; the effect is concentrated in the two smallest size quintiles and is insignificant among the largest 500 names.

The variance risk premium, measured as the difference between one-month implied and subsequently realized S&P 500 variance, averages 1.9 volatility points and predicts index excess returns at the one-month horizon with an adjusted R-squared of 4.7%. Predictive power is economically and statistically negligible beyond one quarter.

Gradient-boosted regression trees trained on 94 firm characteristics attain an out-of-sample monthly R-squared of 0.41%, approximately double the linear benchmark. Ablation indicates that nearly all of the incremental accuracy derives from interactions between size and price momentum rather than from the inclusion of additional predictors.

Under a square-root price-impact specification calibrated to our execution sample, transaction costs absorb 71% of the paper alpha of the short-term reversal strategy at $1bn of deployed capital, implying a break-even capacity of roughly $2.8bn.

Factor momentum spans stock-level momentum: in a time-series regression of the cross-sectional momentum factor on a portfolio of trailing-winner factors, the intercept falls to 0.08% per month (t = 0.44).

We estimate that dealer inventory imbalances in on-the-run Treasuries mean-revert with a half-life of 2.3 business days, and that the associated price pressure is fully reversed within one week, consistent with intermediary risk-bearing capacity rather than information.

Volatility-managed exposure to the market factor, scaled by the inverse of prior-month realized variance, raises the unconditional Sharpe ratio from 0.41 to 0.58 over the full sample. The improvement is not robust in the post-2008 subsample, where the strategy's implied leverage frequently exceeds plausible margin constraints.

Order-flow imbalance accounts for 68% of contemporaneous variation in one-minute returns among large-capitalization names, but for less than 30% in the smallest decile, where quote revision rather than trade pressure dominates price formation.

Corporate bond momentum retains an alpha of 0.34% per month after controlling for the contemporaneous equity momentum of the same issuer, indicating that the effect is not a mechanical transmission of equity-market underreaction into credit.

Dispersion in sell-side earnings forecasts is a substantially better predictor of realized volatility than of returns; augmenting a HAR specification with dispersion reduces out-of-sample RMSE by 6.1%, while its return-predictive coefficient is indistinguishable from zero.

The apparent overnight-to-intraday return reversal weakens by more than half once observations within a three-day window of scheduled earnings announcements are excluded, suggesting that the pattern reflects compensation for announcement risk rather than the unwinding of overnight liquidity provision.

The post-publication half-life of documented anomaly returns has shortened from approximately five years in the pre-2010 sample to under two years thereafter, a pattern more consistent with accelerated arbitrage capital deployment than with in-sample overfitting.
Gross exposure across the combined book is capped at 400% of net asset value, measured at the close of each trading day.
Any position representing more than 5% of NAV requires written pre-approval from the Chief Risk Officer prior to execution.
Level 3 positions are marked monthly using no fewer than two independent pricing sources; where the sources diverge by more than 3%, the more conservative mark prevails.
Stress testing is performed weekly against a standing set of six historical scenarios, including August 2007, September 2008, and March 2020.

Value-at-Risk is calculated at the 99% confidence level over a one-day horizon using two years of equally weighted historical simulation, and is treated as a monitoring measure rather than a binding limit.
A breach of any hard limit must be escalated to the Risk Committee within one business day, and the affected position returned to compliance within three.
Portfolio managers may not transact in instruments outside their approved mandate, irrespective of any hedging rationale offered.
Financing exposure to any single prime broker is limited to 40% of total financing outstanding, and rehypothecation rights are reviewed no less than annually.
The fund maintains an unencumbered cash buffer of not less than 8% of NAV so that margin calls can be met without forced liquidation.
Correlation assumptions embedded in risk aggregation are reviewed quarterly on the standing assumption that cross-asset correlations converge toward one under stress.
Soft limits, including drawdown triggers and concentration flags, require a written explanation from the responsible portfolio manager but do not of themselves compel liquidation.
Trade errors must be reported to Compliance on the day of discovery, and any resulting profit or loss is booked to the management company rather than to the fund.
the universe file only holds current constituents — anything delisted is just gone, so every backtest before ~2019 is quietly survivorship biased.
found it. we compute the signal on the 16:00 close and fill at that same close. that's the whole alpha.
fundamentals in the warehouse are restated values, not point-in-time. use fnd_pit or you're trading on numbers nobody had for another 6 weeks.
vendor adjusted-close gets rewritten every time a new split or div lands, so a run today won't reproduce a run from march. pin the adjustment factors by as-of date.
the 40% single-day return was us forward-filling raw prices across the split date and then applying the factor on top.
half days aren't in our calendar. anything scheduled 15:55 on nov 28 fills against a bar that doesn't exist and silently reuses the prior close.
sharpe on 20d overlapping returns is inflated roughly 1.8x by autocorrelation — newey-west at lag 19, or just resample to non-overlapping windows.
index adds enter on the effective date, not the announcement date. we were long the add for those 5 days and a suspicious amount of pnl lives there.
flat 5bps is fine for the top adv quintile, bottom quintile is more like 30-40 round trip. which is exactly where the strategy makes its money.
~12% of the short book is hard-to-borrow. charge real rebate rates and the short leg contributes about nothing.
groupby().apply() stopped preserving row order after the 2.1 upgrade — that's why the ranks shifted with no code change.
winsorize before you z-score, not after. otherwise the outlier sets the std and everything else compresses toward zero.

Chain-of-thought prompting yields reliable gains only above roughly 60B parameters; below that scale the intermediate traces are often unfaithful and can reduce final-answer accuracy relative to direct prompting.
heads up — our mmlu jumped 4pts after the tokenizer swap and it's just answer-letter formatting, not capability. rerunning with the old normalizer

Reward models trained on human preference data exhibit systematic length bias: with content held constant, annotators favor longer completions, and the resulting policy inflates response length by 30-60% during RLHF without matching quality gains.
lr warmup of 2k steps was too short at 70b, loss spiked around step 11k. bumped to 8k, stable since
Benchmark contamination can be surfaced with canary strings, but n-gram overlap alone understates leakage because paraphrased and translated variants evade exact matching.
fwiw greedy vs temp 0.7 moves gsm8k by ~3 points. always log the decode config, we keep forgetting

Instruction tuning on roughly one thousand heavily curated examples recovers most of the format-following behavior of full-scale SFT, consistent with the view that alignment largely surfaces capabilities already acquired during pretraining.
the judge prefers outputs from its own model family. ~8% swing when we swap judges. use a panel, or at minimum report which judge ran
Four-bit group-wise weight quantization leaves perplexity nearly unchanged while disproportionately degrading long-context retrieval, with the loss growing as a function of position in the sequence.
reminder: don't average pass@1 over subsets of different sizes and call it the benchmark score. macro vs micro matters and we've shipped both by accident

Repeating pretraining data for up to about four epochs produces returns comparable to training on fresh tokens; past that point the marginal value of a repeat decays sharply and can turn negative at small data budgets.
Multiple-choice accuracy scored from option log-likelihoods and accuracy scored from free-form generation diverge substantially for the same checkpoint, and the gap widens after chat tuning.

Models are versioned by the SHA-256 of the serialized artifact, not by a semantic version string, because two training runs with identical code, data, and seed must be provably interchangeable at the registry level.

If online feature freshness lag exceeds 15 minutes, the scorer automatically falls back to the last materialized batch snapshot and emits a degraded-mode counter; page the on-call only after the lag holds above threshold for three consecutive one-minute checks.
the gpu autoscaler scales on queue depth, not utilization — one wedged job pins the pool at max for the whole 30min cooldown and nobody notices until the bill
We observe that calibration degrades substantially faster than top-line accuracy under covariate shift, which implies that accuracy monitoring alone is an insufficient trigger for retraining.

Rollback of a serving model is a registry pointer change, not a redeploy: flip the alias to the previous artifact hash and confirm the new pod set reports it within two health-check intervals before declaring the incident contained.

We rejected a shared multi-tenant feature store for the fraud and recommendation teams because their freshness requirements differ by two orders of magnitude, and the stricter SLA would have set the cost floor for both.
training/serving skew here is almost always the tokenizer version, check that before you go looking at the data

Batch inference jobs write to a staging table and are promoted only after the row-count delta against the previous run falls inside the expected band; a silent partial write is more expensive to detect downstream than a failed job.

The decision to keep offline evaluation and online evaluation on separate metric definitions was deliberate, and the two are not expected to agree in absolute terms; only their directional movement is treated as comparable.
Shadow traffic is mirrored at the load balancer with responses discarded, so any model that writes to external state cannot be shadow-tested without a dry-run flag.
reminder: the retraining dag has no dedupe on the upstream label table, so a backfill that reruns a partition will double-weight those examples

Our ablations indicate that the majority of the observed gain derives from the recency weighting of interaction data rather than from the additional model capacity, and the effect persists when capacity is held fixed.
loss spike at step 41k traced back to one shard of near-duplicate crawl text. dropped the shard, rewound 500 steps, no lr change needed
grad norm clipping at 1.0 is basically inert after ~60k, p99 norm sits around 0.3. keeping it in purely as a spike guard
bf16 params with fp32 master weights is stable. pure bf16 optimizer state blew up twice around 30k, both times in the same layer band
mfu went 51% -> 43% when we moved seq len to 8k. it's the attention kernel falling off its tile size, not comms, profile shows comms flat
z-loss at 1e-4 kills the logit magnitude drift we kept hitting last run and costs nothing measurable on eval
no weight decay on embeddings or layernorm gains. run 7 had it on and we lost about half a point of hellaswag for no stability benefit
the eval regression at 55k was the dataloader, not the model. shuffle seed got reset on resume so it re-fed the first ~2b tokens
2k steps of warmup is enough at this batch size. rewound from the 10k ckpt with 8k warmup and it converged to the same place, just later
checkpoint save blocks the step for ~90s. at every 1k steps that's about 2% of wall clock, async save is worth the eng time
we lose a node roughly every 6 hours at 512 gpus, so ckpt intervals longer than 30 min are a bad trade even with the save cost
mup transfer held from 40m to 1.3b, optimal lr from the proxy sweep was within 2x at full scale. worth re-checking at 7b before we trust it further
tokenizer splits numbers differently depending on whether there's a leading space. probably part of why the arithmetic evals have been flat all run

The strategy harvests the premium that commercial hedgers pay to shed price risk: when inventories are scarce the futures curve slopes downward, and a long position in the front contract earns that premium as the contract rolls toward spot.
Carry for each instrument is computed as the log of the front settlement price divided by the second settlement price, annualized by the number of calendar days between the two expiries.

Raw carry scores are winsorized at the 5th and 95th percentiles and z-scored within sector before being pooled into a single ranking, because the premium is understood to arise from inventory pressure inside a sector rather than across sectors; ranking crude carry directly against ten-year note carry mostly measures the distance between two unrelated markets.

Each rebalance holds the top tercile long and the bottom tercile short, with positions inside each leg scaled inversely to trailing volatility so that every instrument contributes approximately equal risk.

Ex-ante volatility means the annualized standard deviation of daily log returns over a 60-day window, exponentially weighted with a 20-day half-life and floored at the instrument's five-year 10th percentile.

The signal requires daily settlement prices for at least the first three contracts on every curve together with open interest by contract, since the roll is triggered by the open-interest crossover rather than by a fixed day of the month.

Position sizing depends on a covariance matrix estimated from 260 daily returns and shrunk toward a constant-correlation target; without the shrinkage the optimizer hands almost the entire risk budget to the two most collinear rate contracts.

The construction assumes that a trailing 60-day volatility estimate remains a valid forecast across the one-month holding period, and that assumption fails exactly in regime shifts, when the estimate is stalest and gross leverage is at its highest.

Reported backtest returns assume execution at the rebalance day's volume-weighted average price with 1.5 basis points of slippage on developed-market futures and 4 basis points elsewhere, and carry no market-impact term that scales with position size.

No single instrument may carry more than 15% of portfolio risk and no sector more than 40%, and any instrument whose 20-day average dollar volume falls below $50 million is dropped at the next rebalance.
The ranker is a two-stage architecture: a bi-encoder retrieves the top 200 candidates for a query, and a cross-encoder reranks those to the 20 results returned to the caller.
Inputs are the raw query string, the request locale, and a 30-day interaction history truncated to the 50 most recent events; no demographic attributes are used as features.
Relevance is scored as normalized discounted cumulative gain at rank 10, computed against graded labels collected from a trained annotator pool rather than from click logs.
Document embeddings are refreshed on a nightly full rebuild of the serving index; an item ingested at 09:00 is therefore not retrievable until the next build completes.
The model has not been evaluated on queries shorter than three characters, which are roughly 4% of production traffic and are routed to a lexical fallback path.
Calibration is reported as expected calibration error over 15 equal-mass bins, and the current production checkpoint measures 0.031 on the held-out slice.
Training data comes from logged impressions and so inherits the exposure bias of the previous ranker; propensity weighting corrects for position effects but not for items that were never shown.
End-to-end latency is 42 ms at p50 and 180 ms at p99 at 1,200 queries per second per replica; sustained p99 above budget sheds traffic to the retrieval-only path.
The label taxonomy is frozen at v3 because any revision requires re-annotating the full 12,000-item evaluation set, so taxonomy changes are batched and released quarterly.

Accuracy on code-mixed text is unmeasured: the multilingual encoder was fine-tuned on monolingual segments only, and inputs that switch script within a sentence fall outside the evaluated distribution.

The signal is constructed as the residual of five-day realized dispersion regressed on trailing thirty-day dispersion within each GICS sub-industry, standardized cross-sectionally and winsorized at the 1st and 99th percentiles.
In the 2014-2024 backtest on the Russell 1000, the top-minus-bottom decile spread earns 4.1% annualized before costs with a t-statistic of 2.3, which does not clear our 3.0 threshold for allocation.
Rank information coefficient averages 0.021 at a five-day horizon and decays to approximately zero by day eleven, implying the alpha is short-horizon and will not survive weekly rebalancing.
Monthly IC is positive in 71 of 132 months, but the bulk of the cumulative return accrues in 2018 and 2020, so the unconditional Sharpe is not representative of a typical year.
Annualized two-way turnover is roughly 890%, and at 8bps round-trip on the liquid book the net spread falls to approximately 1.2%, leaving little margin for slippage.
Correlation to our existing short-term reversal factor is 0.44 and to residual momentum is -0.19; the incremental contribution after orthogonalization has not yet been measured.

The effect is concentrated in the smallest two size quintiles, where median ADV is under $12M, which raises the possibility that the return is compensation for liquidity provision rather than mispricing.

No out-of-sample or holdout period has been reserved to date; the specification was chosen after examining performance across the full sample and should be treated as in-sample until a 2025-forward test is run.

The economic hypothesis is that dealers widen quotes ahead of idiosyncratic dispersion shocks and the resulting order-flow imbalance mean-reverts over three to five sessions, but we have no direct order-flow data to confirm this channel.

Estimated capacity before market impact halves the net spread is on the order of $60-90M under a square-root impact model with our current participation assumptions, which would make this a satellite sleeve at best.
Gross exposure is capped at 300% of net asset value and net exposure at 120%, measured at the close of each business day; any breach must be reported to the Chief Risk Officer before the next open.
No single issuer may exceed 5% of NAV at cost, and no single position may exceed 20% of the security's twenty-day average daily trading volume.

Position limits are enforced pre-trade in the order management system; overrides require dual authorization from the portfolio manager and a member of the Risk Committee, and every override is logged with its stated rationale.

The firm calculates one-day 99% Value at Risk daily using a two-year historical simulation window, and supplements it with expected shortfall at the same confidence level because VaR alone does not characterize losses in the tail.

Stress testing is conducted weekly against a standing suite of scenarios that includes the 2008 credit crisis, the 2020 liquidity shock, and a parallel 200 basis point rate move, with results circulated to the Investment Committee each Monday.

Portfolio liquidity is assessed monthly under the assumption that the firm may participate in no more than 20% of average daily volume; any strategy in which more than 15% of the portfolio would require over ten days to liquidate is escalated for review.

A drawdown of 5% from a strategy's high-water mark triggers a mandatory review with the Chief Risk Officer, and a 10% drawdown triggers an automatic 50% reduction in risk capital pending Investment Committee approval to restore it.

Counterparty exposure to any single prime broker or derivatives counterparty is limited to 25% of NAV, and all uncleared derivative relationships must operate under an executed ISDA with a two-way credit support annex.

Independent price verification is performed monthly by the valuation team using sources unaffiliated with the trading desk; any position marked more than 3% away from the independent price is escalated to the Valuation Committee for adjudication.

Model risk is managed through independent validation prior to production use and annual revalidation thereafter, and no model may be relied upon for position sizing or hedging until validation is documented and signed off.
the universe file only carries current constituents, so anything that delisted before today is silently missing and the pre-2015 sharpe is mostly survivorship
vendor restates fundamentals in place with no asof column, so joining on report date gives you the corrected numbers rather than what was visible at the time
signal timestamps are exchange-local but the price panel is utc, which buys us a full day of lookahead on the asia names
shift the signal one bar later and sharpe drops 2.1 -> 0.4, so the result is fill timing not alpha
hardcoded 40bps borrow is nowhere near right for the 2008 smallcap shorts, a bunch of those were specials north of 20 pct
the 5 pct adv cap is only applied at sizing, the fill engine still crosses the whole order at vwap
adjusted close is back-adjusted for splits and dividends both, so any level-based or threshold signal built on it is contaminated
halted names still emit a price row via last-trade carryforward and the model will happily trade them
no seed in the config means the walk-forward split reshuffles, so every rerun produces a different oos number
earnings dates in that file are announcement dates not effective dates, so the pre/post split is off by one session for anything reported before the open
loss spike at step ~41k traced back to a shard of near-dupe forum scrape; skipping that shard and rewinding 500 steps cleared it, no arch change needed
z-loss stays at 1e-4. we dropped it to zero on run 6 and the logits drifted big within 10k steps
grad clip at 1.0 is load-bearing on this config, not decorative — at 2.0 we get a spike roughly every 15k steps
we OOM at the optimizer step, not the forward. bf16 compute + fp32 master weights is what eats the pod above ~30b, so shard optimizer state before you touch batch size
idea floated today: swap the mixture toward long-context + code at 80% of the run and hold lr flat instead of decaying to zero. zero ablations behind it so far
swapping mixture without bumping lr gives you a pretty cliff-drop in train loss that never shows up downstream. seen it three times now, don't get excited by the curve
mmlu is flat noise until roughly 1e21 flops then steps up. anything you read off it in the first 20k steps is vibes
checkpoints every 2k steps, keep every 10th. full state is 1.4tb a pop so we physically cannot keep them all
dataloader seed is part of the checkpoint now. resuming without it silently replays the same batches, which is exactly why run 7 looked better than it was
if a wandb run name doesn't match <date>-<confighash>-<seed> it was launched by hand and is not reproducible. treat those as anecdotes

The volatility-scaled version of the carry portfolio earned a net Sharpe ratio of 0.82 over 1998-2025, against 0.61 for the unscaled book, and essentially all of the improvement is attributable to the 2008 and 2020 drawdown quarters.

That the spread has survived more than a decade of publication argues for a funding-constraint interpretation rather than a mispricing one: it widens precisely in the quarters when dealer balance-sheet capacity is scarcest, and it shows no post-publication decay.

The variance decomposition assumes the covariance matrix is stationary within each 60-day estimation window; when a window straddles a regime break, as in March 2020, the estimated factor loadings are not usable.

Adding the news-sentiment factor moved monthly alpha from 42 bps to 38 bps with a Newey-West t-statistic of 0.9, leaving it statistically indistinguishable from zero once momentum and short interest are controlled for.

Results depend on point-in-time fundamentals. Rerunning the identical backtest on the as-reported data inflates the annualized return by roughly 180 bps, entirely through look-ahead in restatement dates.

Capacity is the binding constraint on this strategy: at $2bn of notional the estimated price impact consumes the whole gross spread, so the findings should be read as a small-book result rather than an institutional one.

Practitioners replicating this design should shrink the sample covariance toward a single-factor target before inversion; without shrinkage the minimum-variance weights load on the smallest eigenvalues and turn over roughly three times as fast.

The signal decays with a half-life of about eleven trading days, so a weekly rebalance captures approximately 70% of the theoretically available spread at one-fifth of the turnover of the daily schedule.
The portfolio lost 6.1% on 5 August 2024, its worst single session in the sample, when the carry unwind hit the momentum and low-volatility sleeves simultaneously.

Implementation shortfall is measured here against the decision price rather than the arrival price, which assigns delay cost to the strategy instead of to the execution desk and widens reported costs by 7-9 bps per round trip.
We adopted the model registry as the sole promotion path to production serving; artifacts built outside it are not deployable, regardless of how they were validated.
To roll back a serving deployment, repoint the production alias at the previous model version, drain the canary pool, then restart inference replicas one availability zone at a time.
Every training run must record its dataset snapshot ID, git commit SHA, and random seed in the run manifest before the first checkpoint is written.
Features may not be backfilled from the offline warehouse into the online store without a replay window that excludes the evaluation period.
Feature lookup, not the model forward pass, dominates end-to-end serving latency, which is why the gateway caches the last-known-good feature vector per entity.
A stale feature is one whose materialization timestamp is older than the freshness SLA declared in its feature definition, whether or not the underlying value has changed.
Offline evaluation scores a model against a frozen snapshot; shadow evaluation scores the same model against live traffic without serving its predictions to users.
The autoscaling policy assumes request arrivals are approximately Poisson within a five-minute window, an assumption bursty batch clients violate and which routes them to the async queue instead.

During the 2026-07-02 incident, p99 inference latency held at 40 ms while the feature store's read replicas lagged by nine minutes, so the failure surfaced as silent accuracy loss rather than as timeouts.
Drift alerting depends on the daily baseline job completing by 06:00 UTC; when that job fails the monitor emits no signal at all rather than a stale one.
